headline: Colombia Jobless Rate Drops to 8.0% as Industrial Confidence Climbs
summary: Colombia's unemployment rate declined to 8.0% in September, outperforming forecasts of 9.2%, while factory confidence advanced to 8.3% and retail confidence climbed to 28.6%.
why: Colombian labor and business sentiment indicators guide the central bank's rate trajectory and signal domestic consumer demand strength.

impacts.name: Colombian peso
impacts.why: Stronger employment and sentiment figures indicate resilience in the Colombian macro outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
